note:
Six DDL helpers in odoo/db/schema.py built a type or method token into the statement with nothing that proves the token safe: 15 -> 9, and core is now 0.

Every one is real DDL, so there is no parameter form to move to -- PostgreSQL takes no placeholder for a type name, an index method or an ON DELETE policy. What was missing is the proof, and five of the six had none: `create_model_table` (the column type of every column of every new table), `create_column`, `convert_column`, `_convert_column` and `create_index` interpolated whatever string the caller handed them.

    _SQL_TYPE_TOKEN   an identifier, an optional (..) argument list of word
                      characters, any number of [] suffixes, and any number of
                      further bare keywords -- so `VARCHAR NOT NULL`,
                      `numeric(16, 2)`, `int4[]` and `geometry(Point, 4326)`
                      pass, and nothing carrying a quote, a semicolon or a
                      comment marker does
    _SQL_NAME_TOKEN   a bare identifier, for the index method

The guard caught a real caller on its first run: `_auto_init` appends `" NOT NULL"` to the column type of a required field, so `create_model_table` never receives a type name alone and the first pattern was too narrow. That is the pattern being load-bearing rather than decorative -- `base` would not install under it.

THE SIXTH WAS ALREADY GUARDED AND THE CHECKER COULD NOT SEE IT. `add_foreign_key` rejects an `ondelete` outside `_CONFDELTYPES` two lines above the `SQL(ondelete)`, by raising. `_checker_sql` has had an escape for exactly this proof since it was written -- `_is_asserted`, a name appearing in the test of an `assert` in the enclosing scope -- and an `if <bad>: raise` guard says precisely as much while being the form production code has to use: an assert vanishes under `-O` and states nothing to the caller. `_guard_tests` now yields both, so the checker reads the guard the code already had. Four tests pin the boundary: the assert, the raising guard, a branch that does NOT raise (still a finding), and a guard naming some other value (still a finding).

The floor moves for the six sites only. The addons tree is untouched: the guard-clause reading found nothing there, and the set was diffed rather than the count compared.
